scenario_description:
Objective: Make the booked Friday mast-step inspection physically usable before Talia leaves the boat overnight.
Emerging Need: The appointment has not begun, but the inspection hatch is covered by personal stowage that the crew will not move.
Decision Context: Retrieve the hatch/crate location and safe owner-only relocation rule. Remind Talia to clear and verify the one-meter work area before departure; a draft message alone cannot certify physical readiness.
Consequence: After Talia departs with the boat locked and the hatch still covered, that owner-preparation window is lost before the first-stop visit.

parameter.subject: Friday dockside mast-step inspection openings
parameter.body: Portside has two Friday openings for30-foot sailboats. A booking deposit creates a route ticket; owners must clear the mast-step inspection work area before the visit because technicians do not move personal belongings or fixed furniture.

parameter.description: Refundable deposit authorization for a Friday dockside mast-check route ticket; dispatch confirmation pending.

parameter.title: Portside dockside mast-check appointment
parameter.description: Provisional Friday 08:00 first-stop mast-step inspection; owner must leave the hatch and one-meter work area accessible. Talia plans to leave Thursday 16:00 for an overnight visit, returning Friday 12:00.

parameter.subject: Route ticket PM-44 packet status
parameter.body: PM-44 is assigned to Friday 08:00 at Foss Harbor B-18. The marina has arranged normal escorted vendor entry; no access-code submission is needed. The owner must clear loose stowage from the mast-step hatch and one-meter work area before leaving. Crew may open the removable inspection cover but cannot relocate belongings or undo rigging to reach it.

parameter.content: I am aboard until the 16:00 ferry departure today and return at noon tomorrow. I still have a few loose storage boxes by the dinette. The mast-check crew comes before I get back; I have not checked which box covers their inspection hatch.

I am on the ferry with the cabin locked. I left the blue spares crate on the mast-step cover, and nobody else has permission to enter or move it. I will not be back before the 08:00 inspection; Portside has confirmed they cannot do the hatch check while that work area is blocked.
